nusmp.skill.grimoire_barrier.description: Grimoire magic: Barrier Magic. Barrier Magic shapes honeycomb walls of hexagons that can be resized, moved and turned into weapons. Its pages fire homing hex shards, fold barrier into swords, axes, arrows and tridents, raise glass walls, turn shots back on their senders, wrap you in a protective skin, jam enemy casting and lock down spatial escapes, and finally raise the Voodoo Shangrila and Voodoo Kingdom domes that trap foes and shelter allies. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.skill.book_barrier.description: The grimoire of Barrier Magic: twelve pages of hexagonal barriers. Starters throw hex shards and slide you forward on a barrier step; mid pages make voodoo weapons, a barrier cannon, a hexagon wall, a deflecting pane, a healing barrier skin and a spatial lock that jams casters; the zone and signature pages raise the Shangrila and Kingdom domes; the daily page draws spent barrier back into your body. Hold the grimoire, hold the skill key to chant, release to cast.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_strike: Barrier Strike - a hexagon of hard barrier is thrown in a straight line from the hand. It flies up to about 22 blocks, pierces through every foe in its path and deals 8 base damage to each (scaled by your EP).
nusmp.page.book_barrier.hex_shards: Hex Shards - three small hexagons peel off the barrier and curve after the nearest foes like swallows. Each shard deals 4.5 base damage, shoves the target slightly and weakens it for 3 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_step: Barrier Step - the barrier is laid flat under your feet and you slide along it in one motion. You move up to 8 blocks forward, hit everything on the way for 4 base damage and slow it for 1.5 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.voodoo_regalia: Voodoo Regalia - the barrier is shaped into a sword, an axe, an arrow and a trident and fired in a fan. The sword cuts and bleeds 4% of the target's magicules (6 damage, pierces), the axe breaks the guard (9 damage, fragility and weakness for 4 seconds), the arrow is fast (5 damage, pierces) and the trident hits the marked target and heaves it into the air (7 damage). The remaining barrier stays in your hand for 7 seconds and adds 3 damage to every melee hit.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_cannon: Barrier Cannon - plates of barrier align into a cannon barrel and loose a beam. It reaches about 26 blocks, deals 14 base damage to everything in a 1-block-wide line, knocks foes back and jams their magic for 4 seconds (1 second on bosses), and shatters hostile barriers and spell constructs within 3.5 blocks of where it ends.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.hexagon_wall: Hexagon Wall - cell by cell, a pane wall unfolds before you. It is 7 blocks wide and 4 high, made of translucent glass cells that block movement and sight lines for 12 seconds and then fade away.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.deflecting_pane: Deflecting Pane - a shell of barrier rings you for 8 seconds, radius 4.5 blocks. Every hostile arrow, bolt and thrown spell that touches it is turned around and sent back as yours, enemy spell bolts are dissolved, and you take 20% less damage meanwhile.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_armour: Barrier Armour - barrier material wraps your body like a bandage over every wound. You heal 6 health, put out flames and are cleansed of poison, and gain Resistance II and Absorption II for 20 seconds. Allied players within 6 blocks get a thinner coat of Absorption for 15 seconds.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.spatial_lock: Spatial Lock - the barrier is tuned against spatial and ultimate magic. Every foe within 7 blocks takes 3 base damage, has its magic jammed for 8 seconds, is anchored by Slowness III for 5 seconds and has its ultimate skills thrown onto cooldown for 8 seconds. Bosses are held for only 2 seconds and jammed for 2.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.voodoo_shangrila: Voodoo Shangrila - countless hexagons knit into a dome of 7 blocks radius around where you stand, lasting 12 seconds. Foes inside cannot leave, foes outside cannot enter, hostile projectiles break on the shell, and the trapped are magic-jammed. Allies pass freely and receive Resistance and Regeneration while they stay inside. Bosses are pushed back more weakly.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.voodoo_kingdom: Voodoo Kingdom - the Shangrila grown into a realm: an 11-block-radius dome that lasts 15 seconds. Foes are locked in, jammed and weakened, and every second barrier weapons fall on up to three of them for 6 base damage each. Allies inside gain Resistance II, Strength and Regeneration.
nusmp.page.book_barrier.barrier_reclaim: Barrier Reclaim - the barrier you have raised all day is drawn back into your body. Every harmful status effect is cleansed, you heal a quarter of your maximum health, and you gain Strength II, Speed II and Resistance for 30 seconds.
